# Uber Eats

> Uber Eats is a food and alcohol delivery platform connecting customers with restaurants, grocery stores, and convenience stores for same-day delivery.

The platform operates globally, offering restaurant meals, alcohol, and grocery delivery through its mobile app and website. Uber Eats partners with major chains like 7-Eleven, Walgreens, Domino's, and local restaurants to provide on-demand delivery services with real-time order tracking.

## Key Topics

- food delivery
- alcohol delivery
- same-day delivery
- restaurant ordering
- online ordering
- order tracking
- convenience stores
- grocery delivery
- liquor stores
- menu prices
- 7-Eleven
- Walgreens
- SNAP EBT
- Uber Eats app
